lines.description: BetaFPV Meteor75 Pro II O4 PNP (ELRS) - parts donor: Matrix 1S 3IN1 FC/12A ESC/ELRS RX (25.5 mm mount, BT2.0 lead, no video TX), 4x 1102 21000KV (2026) motors on JST1.25 plugs, GF1811 45 mm props, plus its stock frame as a fallback
lines.vendor_pn: Meteor75 Pro II O4 PNP ELRS
lines.acceptance_note: Cheaper than its board ($39.99) and motors ($39.99) bought apart, and the only verified all-plug-in, no-video-TX set. Not on Amazon. The all-Amazon fallback (Matrix 5IN1 5A B0DQ8FH3VV + 1102 18000KV B0834P2LSY) is about $7 more and carries a video TX and a 5 A ESC.

lines.description: BetaFPV LiteRadio 3 ELRS transmitter (USB joystick for simulators; built-in battery)
lines.note: Upgrade worth keeping: RadioMaster Pocket ELRS, Amazon B0CG93QM4T $79.99 + 2x 18650 cells. Do NOT buy the Amazon 'LiteRadio 3' listing B09PV86XXY - it is the FrSky version and cannot bind ELRS.
